description: Ireland: statutory interest and fixed compensation on a late business-to-business or public-body invoice (S.I. 580/2012). Rate = ECB main refinancing rate in force before 1 January or 1 July + 8 percentage points (10.4% for payments overdue 1 July to 31 December 2026); interest = debt x days late x rate / 365, using the rate on the day the payment became overdue (Department of Enterprise method, reproduces its example); compensation EUR40 (debt up to EUR1,000), EUR70 (to EUR10,000), EUR100 above. If the contract sets no date, payment is due 30 days after the invoice is received. Use this when someone in Ireland asks how much interest they can charge a customer who paid late.
